articles.title_en: Manchester City and Liverpool clash as title race intensifies
articles.title_ru: Манчестер Сити и Ливерпуль встречаются в решающем матче чемпионата
articles.preview_en: Manchester City travels to Liverpool seeking a win to keep pace in the Premier League title race.
articles.preview_ru: Манчестер Сити отправляется в Ливерпуль, чтобы победить и сохранить шансы в гонке за титул.
articles.full_en: Manchester City arrives in Liverpool on Sunday with a determined squad aiming to extend their unbeaten run. Liverpool hosts the match at Anfield, where the home side has secured ten points from their last three games. The encounter comes as both clubs vie for the Premier League lead, with City currently three points ahead of Liverpool. A victory for Manchester City would solidify their position at the top and increase pressure on their rivals. A win for Liverpool could narrow the gap and revive their title aspirations. Both managers are expected to field their strongest line-ups, with City likely to rely on Kevin De Bruyne's creativity and Liverpool on Mohamed Salah's pace. Fans anticipate a high-octane battle that could shape the championship narrative for the remainder of the season.
articles.full_ru: Манчестер Сити прибывает в Ливерпуль в воскресенье с решительным настроем, желая продлить свою беспроигрышную серию. Ливерпуль принимает соперника на «Энфилде», где хозяева набрали десять очков в последних трёх матчах. Матч проходит на фоне борьбы за первое место в Премьер-лиге, где Сити опережает Ливерпуль на три очка. Победа Манчестер Сити укрепит их лидерство и усилит давление на соперников. Победа Ливерпуля сократит разрыв и возродит их шансы на титул. Оба тренера, вероятно, выберут лучшие составы, при этом Сити будет полагаться на креатив Кевина Де Брёйна, а Ливерпуль — на скорость Мохамеда Салаха. Зрители ожидают захватывающее противостояние, которое может определить ход чемпионата до конца сезона.
articles.meta_en: Manchester City seeks to extend unbeaten run at Anfield while Liverpool aims to close the title gap in a decisive Premier League clash.
articles.meta_ru: Манчестер Сити пытается продолжить беспроигрышную серию в Ливерпуле, а Ливерпуль стремится сократить разрыв в гонке за титул.

articles.preview_en: The often-criticised pop artist is the focus of a monumental new survey including rarely seen pieces and ambitious new restagings at New York’s Whitney Museum When the American artist Roy Lichtenstein
articles.preview_ru: The often-criticised pop artist is the focus of a monumental new survey including rarely seen pieces and ambitious new restagings at New York’s Whitney Museum When the American artist Roy Lichtenstein
articles.full_en: The often-criticised pop artist is the focus of a monumental new survey including rarely seen pieces and ambitious new restagings at New York’s Whitney Museum When the American artist Roy Lichtenstein created his monumental Greene Street Mural in 1983, he took inspiration from the Bayeux tapestry for its serial storytelling technique. But whereas the embroidery depicting the Norman conquest continues to delight after nearly 1,000 years, Lichtenstein’s site-specific mural was destroyed after six weeks, in accordance with his wishes. More than four decades later, however, the monumental Greene Street Mural is to mesmerise art lovers once more. This week a 96ft (29-metre) recreation of the work will span the entire entryway to Roy Lichtenstein: Like New, the first major New York retrospective of the pop artist’s work in 33 years, at the Whitney Museum of American Art.
